title: VLT Project Command v4
description: Collaboration v4. Retains the v3 external plugin contract and adds expressive MIDI, MIDI take content and atomic multipart MIDI recording. Previous command schemas remain immutable.

midiComp.$comment: The runtime additionally requires endSeconds > startSeconds.

prepareMidiPayload.$comment: The runtime additionally requires index < count and enforces consistent part counts/content ids across an upload.
